description: [plugins.scribe] settings for the Codex-enabled Orbit package.

root.description: The scribe data directory, an absolute path (the CLI's ~/.scribe). The sandbox grants access to it alone. The default, /var/tmp, means unset: every tool answers not_configured until it is set.

transcripts.description: Claude Code's projects directory, an absolute path (~/.claude/projects, or $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/projects). scribe.session-pass reads the transcripts of sessions switched on with /scribe on there; until it is set (the default is empty), it answers not_configured.

codex_home.description: Absolute existing Codex state directory, read-only for existing auth/config/transcripts. Required by this package; use the default Orbit package for Claude-only installations.

codex_runtime_tmp.description: Absolute existing tmp directory inside codex_home; Codex needs this narrow directory write at startup.

codex_installation_id.description: Absolute existing installation_id regular file inside codex_home; exact-file write only, with no symlinks or hard links.
